description: Wallet Nfts: Lists ERC-721 and ERC-1155 tokens held by a wallet through Blockscout, one page per call (the explorer's own page size, 50 items). pageItemCount, returnedNfts and nftsTruncated say what this response carries; hasMore and nextCursor say another page exists and how to ask for it. Blockscout exposes no total, so this response does not claim one. 🆓 5 free trial calls per signed wallet
